title: Thurgood Marshall College General Education
source_note: Marshall 学院官网 GE 页 + 一年级 GE 页（2026-10-28 核对）；学科广度可选系随专业而定，只写规则。

sections.title: Dimensions of Culture

requirements.name: Dimensions of Culture
requirements.note: Three-course sequence DOC 1 (4 units, fall only), DOC 2 (6 units, winter only), DOC 3 (6 units, spring only). Must be taken at UCSD, letter grade only. ELWR must be satisfied before DOC 2/3.
requirements.note_zh: DOC 1（4 学分，仅秋）+ DOC 2（6 学分，仅冬）+ DOC 3（6 学分，仅春），须在 UCSD 修、只接受 letter grade；修 DOC 2/3 前须先满足 UC 入学写作要求。

sections.note: DOC 1/2/3, at UCSD only, letter grade only.
sections.note_zh: DOC 1/2/3，须在 UCSD 修、只接受 letter grade。

sections.title: Natural Sciences

requirements.name: Natural Sciences
requirements.note: 3 courses: one Biology + one Chemistry + one Physics, from the approved lists. Courses available for science and nonscience majors; overlap with major sciences encouraged.
requirements.note_zh: 自然科学 3 门：生物、化学、物理各 1 门（批准清单内）；建议选可与专业科学课重叠的课。

sections.note_zh: 生物、化学、物理各 1 门。

requirements.name: Mathematics, Statistics, and Logic
requirements.note: 2 courses, three options: (A) two Mathematics/Advanced Statistics; (B) one Mathematics/Advanced Statistics + one Introductory Statistics or Computer Programming & Logic; (C) one Introductory Statistics + one Computer Programming & Logic.
requirements.note_zh: 2 门，三种组合：(A) 数学/高阶统计 2 门；(B) 数学/高阶统计 1 门 + 入门统计或编程与逻辑 1 门；(C) 入门统计 1 门 + 编程与逻辑 1 门。

sections.title: Humanities and Cultural Studies

requirements.name: Humanities and Cultural Studies
requirements.note: 2 courses from the approved list in domestic and global cultures.
requirements.note_zh: 人文与文化研究 2 门（批准清单：本土与全球文化方向）。

sections.note: 2 courses in domestic and global cultures.
sections.note_zh: 本土与全球文化方向 2 门。

sections.title: Fine Arts

requirements.name: Fine Arts
requirements.note: 1 course from Music, Theatre & Dance, or Visual Arts. MUS 80 must be taken for 4 units to count.
requirements.note_zh: 美术 1 门（音乐/戏剧舞蹈/视觉艺术）；MUS 80 须修满 4 学分才计入。

sections.note: 1 course in Music, Theatre & Dance, or Visual Arts.
sections.note_zh: 音乐/戏剧舞蹈/视觉艺术 1 门。

sections.title: Disciplinary Breadth

requirements.name: Disciplinary Breadth
requirements.note: 4 four-unit courses outside the major field of study; two must be upper division; at least one upper-division course must include significant writing (from the college Significant Writing list). Eligible departments depend on the major (see the college page major selector). The four-unit public service option may fulfill one breadth course and the upper-division writing requirement. Breadth courses cannot overlap major courses.
requirements.note_zh: 学科广度 4 门（4 学分）：须在专业领域之外，其中 2 门高年级，至少 1 门高年级须含 significant writing（学院 Significant Writing 清单内）；可选系随专业而定（见学院页按专业查询）；4 学分公共服务课可抵 1 门广度并满足高年级写作要求；广度课不得与专业课重叠。

sections.note: 4 courses outside the major; 2 upper division, 1 with writing.
sections.note_zh: 专业领域外 4 门，2 门高年级、1 门高年级含写作。

sections.title: Transfer Students

requirements.name: Upper-division writing + breadth
requirements.name_zh: 转学生高年级写作与广度
requirements.note: Transfer students (all): one four-unit upper-division college-approved writing course + one four-unit upper-division disciplinary breadth course noncontiguous to the major. IGETC/UC Reciprocity transfers: same two courses (no further lower-division coursework). Without an articulation agreement, see an academic advisor.
requirements.note_zh: 转学生：一门 4 学分高年级学院批准写作课 + 一门 4 学分高年级学科广度课（须与专业不相关）；IGETC/UC Reciprocity 转学生同此两门，不再补低年级课；无衔接协议者见学术顾问。

sections.note_zh: 转学生：高年级写作 1 门 + 高年级广度 1 门。
